title: Integer density, layer decomposition and truncation bounds for a compactly supported top-dimensional integer multiplicity current (Simon 6.3.14 first step and (3)–(7), 2.35, 3.15)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and let R ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(ℝ^{n+1}) be integer multiplicity with compact support. Then there are Borel sets U_j ⊆ ℝ^{n+1} (j ∈ ℤ) with U_{j+1} ⊆ U_j, and currents X_j ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(ℝ^{n+1}) with X_j(ω) = ∫_{U_j} ω(x)(e_0, …, e_n) dL^{n+1}(x) for every ω (X_j = [[U_j]]), such that: (i) for every η ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^{n+1}) the family (∂X_j(η))_{j∈ℤ} is summable with sum ∂R(η) (HasSum); (ii) M(∂X_j) ≤ M(∂R) for every j; (iii) for every N ∈ ℕ and every Y ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+1}) with Y(η) = Σ_{j=−N}^{N} ∂X_j(η) for all η, M(Y) ≤ M(∂R). Here M = mass = M_{ℝ^{n+1}} in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (n + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R → IsCompact R.support → ∃ (U : ℤ → Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (X : ℤ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (n + 1)), (∀ j, MeasurableSet (U j)) ∧ (∀ j, U (j + 1) ⊆ U j) ∧ (∀ (j : ℤ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (n + 1)), X j ω = ∫ x in U j, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (n + 1)) (n + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) ∧ (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) n, HasSum (fun j => (X j).boundary η) (R.boundary η)) ∧ (∀ j, (X j).boundary.mass ≤ R.boundary.mass) ∧ ∀ (N : ℕ) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) n), (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) n, Y η = ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) N, (X j).boundary η) → Y.mass ≤ R.boundary.mass
